assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and near-syncope

The patient has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
The patient has atherosclerotic heart disease coded as I25.10
The patient has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency coded as I34.0
There is a concern for intermittent arrhythmia as the underlying etiology of the collapse events
Cardiac event monitoring (CPT 93271) is medically necessary to capture rhythm data during symptomatic periods
The monitoring addresses the payer's coverage determination PR-204
The monitoring documents the diagnostic necessity of the service for evaluating the patient's documented syncope episodes
